metadata.name: V60 Pour Game Logic
metadata.purpose: Central editable logic map for simulation formulas, constants, profiles, ranges, and thresholds.
notes: Formulas are stored as expression strings for AI review and tuning.
This file documents current behavior; app runtime still uses Brew.tsx unless wired to load from this config.
Units: mass=g, time=s, temperature=C, conductivity=(sim EC units).

v2.0 changes: TDS physical floor/ceiling now ratio-dependent; Dp derived from grindUm; aTop from V60 geometry; mu wired into Darcy q; fines migration added; channelMemory accumulation fixed; timeConst re-anchored; combined Stuck multiplier ceiling added.

constants._note_bedRadius_removed: bedRadius was a fixed constant used as aTop proxy. Replaced by aTop derived from v60Specs geometry per size. See model.darcyFilter.aTop.

lookups._note_v60Specs_aTop: aTop in m² = pi * (top_radius_m)^2, used directly in Darcy q. Values: 01=pi*0.049^2, 02=pi*0.058^2, 03=pi*0.067^2. Replaces fixed bedRadius constant.

stateDefaults._note_finesPctEff: finesPctEff is a runtime state variable initialised to finesPct and allowed to grow up to finesPct*1.8 via fines migration. It replaces the static finesPct in all bed and Darcy calculations.

computeDp._note: Effective spherical particle diameter in metres. 0.65 converts nominal cut size to volume-equivalent sphere. Used in Kozeny-Carman kKozeny. Previously Dp was a fixed constant; now grind size meaningfully changes bed resistance.

waterViscosityPaS._note: mu is now passed into the Darcy q formula. Previously computed but not used in q.

solubilityFactor._note: Adjusted coefficients vs v1: base 0.72→0.70, slope 0.017→0.019, ceiling 1.15→1.18. Slightly more sensitive to temperature.

roastExtractionFactor._note: Replaces v1 roastFactor lookup (dark:1.4, medium:1.0, light:0.7). Dark reduced 1.4→1.35 to avoid TDS ceiling blowout with Stuck grounds. Light raised 0.7→0.72 for marginal realism.

geometry._note_aTop: Use v60Specs[v60Size].aTop (m²) directly. This replaces the old bedRadius-based proxy and ensures Darcy flow scales correctly with cone size.

darcyFilter._note: aTop now from v60Specs geometry. Dp now from computeDp (grind-dependent). mu now wired into q. All three were gaps in v1.
darcyFilter._note_eps: finesPct coefficient 0.12→0.14, integrityTerm 0.06→0.07 for slightly stronger fines/compaction coupling. Uses finesPctEff (migrated value) not raw finesPct.
darcyFilter._note_alphaBase: Lower bound 0.15→0.12. Slant factor explicit (0.82). Uses real aTop.
darcyFilter._note_lBed: min 0.005→0.004, max 0.04→0.045 for wider dose range.
darcyFilter._note_q: mu now explicitly included. In v1 mu was computed but the q expression used a fixed implicit viscosity. This makes tempC affect flow rate realistically (~30% faster at 93°C vs 80°C).

groundCompaction.groundStatus: Loose if <33, Muddy if <70, else Stuck

extractionRateFactor._note: Stuck reduced 1.12→1.10 to avoid compounding with tdsConcentrationFactor.

tdsConcentrationFactor._note: Loose tightened 0.78→0.82 (realistic floor). Stuck reduced 1.12→1.08. Combined Stuck ceiling is now 1.10*1.08=1.188 vs old 1.12*1.12=1.254 — prevents unrealistic TDS spikes. Muddy unchanged.

bloomAndDegas.bloomProgress: if poured<=0 then 0 else min(1, max(elapsed/bloomTimeSec, poured/max(1,bloomWaterTarget)))

channelRisk.turbulenceTerm: if isPouring then max(0,(pourRate-4.5)/11) * (0.07 + 0.42*heightNorm) * dryImpactBoost else 0
channelRisk.channelRawBase: headTerm + drainTerm + integrityTerm + finesTerm + turbulenceTerm + memoryTerm
channelRisk.lowHeadRelief: if !inBloom and inDripper < dose*0.15 then 0.55 else 1
channelRisk.channelRisk: if inDripper<=0 then 0 else min(1, if inBloom then min(0.18, channelRaw*bloomSuppression) else min(0.62, channelRaw*lowHeadRelief))

pourDynamics.responseSec: if targetPour <= 6 then 0.8 else max(1.5, dripperMeta.pourRampSec * (targetPour/10))

diffusionImmersion.avgWaterContactAgeUpdate: if curInDripAfterDrain>0.02 then ((max(0,curInDripAfterDrain-addedFreshThisTick) * (prevAge + timeStep)) / max(1e-6,curInDripAfterDrain)) else 0

extractionTds._note_roastFactor: Now references functions.roastExtractionFactor table (dark:1.35, medium:1.0, light:0.72). Old values: dark:1.4, light:0.7.
extractionTds.timeConst: 28 / drainRate / max(0.4,surfaceArea/28000) / roastFactor / tempSolubility / max(0.5,extractionRateFactor) / max(0.28,waterEffectiveness)
extractionTds._note_timeConst: Base divisor 30→28 (slightly faster extraction). surfaceArea divisor 30000→28000. waterEffectiveness min guard 0.3→0.28. Re-anchored so medium/washed/93°C/1:15 at ~3min yields ~19-20% EY.
extractionTds.waterMass: if drained>0.5 then drained else max(0.1,poured)
extractionTds._note_waterMass: Threshold 0.1→0.5 so early-brew TDS is not computed on near-zero drained mass.
extractionTds._note_cupDilutionFactor: FIXED. Lower bound was flat 0.58. Now ratio-dependent: 0.52*sqrt(ratio/16). At 1:10 floor=0.41, at 1:16 floor=0.52, at 1:20 floor=0.58. Prevents TDS from being artificially floored at high ratios.
extractionTds._note_tdsFloorCeil: FIXED. v1 had flat clamp(0.72, 3.2). Floor and ceiling are now ratio-dependent. Examples: ratio 10 → floor 1.05, ceil 2.75. ratio 15 → floor 0.77, ceil 2.37. ratio 20 → floor 0.60, ceil 2.08. ratio 25 → floor 0.49, ceil 1.86.
extractionTds.tds: if drained>0.5 then clamp(tdsFloor, tdsCeil, tdsRaw) else 0
extractionTds._note_tds: Guard: do not emit TDS until drained>0.5g to avoid divide-near-zero artefacts.

ecModel.targetSlurry: if inBloom then bloomPeak else clamp(3.5,22,postBase-washDrop)
ecModel._note_transfer: min 0.35→0.33, max 0.85→0.82, base 0.52→0.50, saturationIndex coeff 0.25→0.24, channelRisk coeff 0.18→0.16.

bedDynamics._note_decayPerSec: Coefficients slightly reduced: contactIntensity 0.012→0.011, aggression 0.02→0.018, channelRisk 0.01→0.009.
bedDynamics._note_cakeBuild: Uses finesPctEff. Coefficients: base 0.006→0.005, contactIntensity 0.006→0.005, aggression 0.02→0.018.

channelMemory._note: FIXED. v1 only decayed channelMemory — it never grew except from the channelRaw formula itself creating a weak implicit feedback. Now explicitly accumulates +channelRisk*0.02*dt each tick so prolonged channeling builds meaningful memory. Decay coefficients 0.012→0.011 (idle), 0.004 unchanged.

finesMigration.expression: finesPctEff = clamp(finesPct, finesPct*1.8, finesPctEff + 0.002 * throughputKg * timeStep)
finesMigration._note: NEW in v2. finesPctEff grows up to 180% of base finesPct as water washes fine particles toward the paper. throughputKg is the cumulative drained mass in kg. This means a brew that drains quickly sees less fines migration than a slow-draining brew. Feeds into eps, finesTerm, bloomPeakBase, cakeBuild, and groundCompaction.

planner.observedCupRate: if drained>20 and elapsed>10 then drained/elapsed else waterVol/max(1,expectedFinishSec)

statusAndThresholds._note_flowLabel: Added 'Good' band between Moderate and Fast.
statusAndThresholds._note_channelRiskLabel: High threshold 0.65→0.62 to match channelRisk ceiling change.
statusAndThresholds._note_serveResult: Added TDS-based Weak/Strong outcomes alongside EY-based Under/Over.

tdsPhysicalMin.note: At ratio 1:10 floor is ~1.05%, at 1:16 ~0.77%, at 1:20 ~0.60%. No longer unrealistically high at shorter ratios or unrealistically unconstrained at longer ratios.

dpFixedConstant.note: Dp is now derived from grindUm via computeDp. Grind size now meaningfully affects Kozeny-Carman bed resistance and therefore drain rate.

muNotWiredIntoDarcy.note: waterViscosityPaS was computed but the q expression previously used an implicit fixed viscosity. mu is now explicit in q = deltaP*aTop / (mu*(rBed+rFilterEffective)).

aTopFixedBedRadius.note: aTop now taken from v60Specs[v60Size].aTop rather than a fixed bedRadius. Flow scales correctly with V60 size.

channelMemoryNeverAccumulated.note: channelMemory now explicitly accumulates +channelRisk*0.02*dt per tick. Previously only decayed.

finesStatic.note: finesPctEff migrates up to 1.8x base finesPct as brew progresses, driven by throughputKg.
